name: list_calls
description:
List recorded call metadata, optionally bounded by an ISO-8601 date range.

        ``workspaceId`` filters the way ``GET /v2/calls`` does and
        ``primaryUserIds`` the way the ``POST /v2/calls/extensive`` filter does,
        so an agent can ask for one rep's calls without reading the workspace.
        Returns one page under ``calls``; pass ``records.cursor`` back as ``cursor``
        for the next one.

fromDateTime.title: Fromdatetime
fromDateTime.description: Start of the range, inclusive, as an ISO-8601 instant (e.g. '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z').

toDateTime.title: Todatetime
toDateTime.description: End of the range, exclusive, as an ISO-8601 instant; defaults to now.

workspaceId.title: Workspaceid
workspaceId.description: The Gong workspace to read; a single workspace is available.

primaryUserIds.title: Primaryuserids
primaryUserIds.description: Only calls hosted by these users, by Gong id.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum records in this page; never widens a page past the workspace's page size.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: The 'records.cursor' from the previous page; omit for the first page.

name: get_call
description:
Fetch one call with its parties, AI content, and interaction stats (e.g. ``call-0``).

        The argument is ``callId``, spelled as Gong's own API spells it rather
        than as ``call_id``: every tool here takes the vendor's parameter names,
        so a prompt or client written against Gong reads the same either way.

        An unknown call id fails with Gong's own "Call with id ... was not
        found" rather than answering null, which an agent read as an empty call.

name: list_calls_extensive
description:
Calls with their parties, AI content and interaction stats, a page at a time (``POST /v2/calls/extensive``).

        The bulk form of ``get_call``: who attended which call across a whole
        workspace is one paged walk here, not a fetch per call.
        ``contentSelector`` takes Gong's own shape — ``{"exposedFields":
        {"parties": true}}`` for the party lists, ``{"context": "Extended"}`` to
        add each call's CRM context — and selects metadata only when omitted.

fromDateTime.title: Fromdatetime
fromDateTime.description: Start of the range, inclusive, as an ISO-8601 instant (e.g. '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z').

toDateTime.title: Todatetime
toDateTime.description: End of the range, exclusive, as an ISO-8601 instant; defaults to now.

workspaceId.title: Workspaceid
workspaceId.description: The Gong workspace to read; a single workspace is available.

primaryUserIds.title: Primaryuserids
primaryUserIds.description: Only calls hosted by these users, by Gong id.

callIds.title: Callids
callIds.description: The calls to fetch by Gong id. Unknown ids are absent from the answer.

contentSelector.title: Contentselector
contentSelector.description: Which blocks to expose per call, in Gong's own shape: {'exposedFields': {'parties': true, 'interaction': true, 'content': {'brief': true}}, 'context': 'Extended'}. Omitted, each call answers metadata only.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum records in this page; never widens a page past the workspace's page size.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: The 'records.cursor' from the previous page; omit for the first page.

name: get_call_transcript
description:
Fetch the speaker-attributed transcript for one call.

description:
Retrieve speaker-attributed transcripts for several calls at once.

        Selects exactly what ``POST /v2/calls/transcript`` selects for the same
        ids: a call that does not exist is absent from the page instead of
        appearing with an empty transcript that reads like a silent call.

callIds.title: Callids

        Takes Gong's read enum (``DEAL``/``ACCOUNT``/``CONTACT``/``LEAD``) as
        well as the stored object name, so the documented ``DEAL`` no longer
        answers an empty page where REST answers the opportunities. Asking for
        specific ``objectsCrmIds`` answers REST's ``crmObjectsMap`` — the
        object's fields keyed by crm id, ``null`` for one Gong does not have.
